prompt: Edit this candle flame sprite sheet to remove the narrow, upright, nearly rectangular dark wick mark inside the bottom of each of the eight flames. Replace each mark with a continuous natural smoky-orange to faint-blue flame gradient, retaining a rounded base. There must be no dark vertical line, object or wick anywhere. Preserve exactly eight separated flames in the same order in a single horizontal row, their respective tip shapes, the alignment and spacing, the realistic painted warm-white-yellow cores, soft golden-orange edges, faint blue at the very bottom, and the pure RGB #000000 black surroundings. Keep the soft glow close to each flame. Only change the small wick-like marks and immediately surrounding interior at the bottom of each flame. No outlines, objects, candles, wax, sparks, smoke, borders, reflections or text.
process: Generated with built-in image_gen using the painted tavern flames as the style reference. Cropped, resized and aligned each frame with sharp on a shared baseline, clamped pixels with all RGB channels below 6 to black, then exported lossless WebP and a 2x PNG preview.
